vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm, the doctor taught the woman in her 40s, with restless hands Steady Hands.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Christian, Illari, Yasuaki, Oliver and Xavier met them at the door — 5 put down. Christian, Illari, Yasuaki, Oliver, Xavier are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Christian just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Christian, Illari, Yasuaki and Xavier met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Christian, Illari, Yasuaki are hurt.
🛡️ Kieran, Illari, Yasuaki and Mara met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Illari, Yasuaki, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Illari just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Anna, Illari, Yasuaki and Mara met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Anna, Illari, Yasuaki, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kieran just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Illari showed Kieran the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Sanne showed Xavier the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
